hardware_electronic_equipment.model_policy_reason: FCFF is the primary governed model for the hardware and services archetype; EPV is a separate no-growth support value.

enterprise_software_cloud.model_policy_reason: FCFF is the primary governed model for the enterprise software and cloud archetype; EPV is a separate no-growth support value.

semiconductors_and_components.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — semiconductors & components. Calibrated to 20 SEC comparables: growth mean-reverted from AI-peak 5y CAGR (obs median 0.18, range -0.10..1.30); operating margin blends fabless (~0.30-0.40) and EMS (~0.03-0.05, obs median 0.137); observed ROIC ~0.16, book debt-weight ~0.21. sales_to_capital set on governed reinvestment scale (not trailing book ratio). Recalibrate splitting semis vs EMS.

medical_devices_instruments.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — medical devices & instruments. Calibrated to 12 SEC comparables: obs revenue CAGR median 0.075, operating margin median 0.20, ROIC ~0.15, book debt-weight ~0.27. Defensive beta by judgment; durable-moat terminal premium.

diversified_industrials.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — aerospace/machinery/industrials. Calibrated to 9 SEC comparables (small n): growth mean-reverted to GDP+ (obs median 0.095 noisy); operating margin 0.13 excludes BA distress (obs median 0.103); observed ROIC ~0.15, book debt-weight ~0.38 (one negative-equity outlier). Cyclical beta by judgment.

pharmaceuticals.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — pharma/biotech. Calibrated 14 SEC comparables (ABT,JNJ,AMGN,GILD,VRTX...): growth mean-reverted (obs median 0.021, biotech noise to 1.7); big-pharma margin ~0.25; ROIC ~0.16; book debt-weight ~0.34. Pre-revenue biotech will still withhold.

specialty_chemicals.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — chemicals & household/personal products. Cohort MIXES industrial gas/chem (APD,LIN,ECL) with household/personal care (PG,CL,EL,KVUE) — SPLIT before publish. obs growth 0.039, margin 0.198, ROIC 0.116, debt-weight 0.395.

consumer_staples.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — food/beverage/tobacco. Calibrated 8 comparables (KO,PEP,MO,PM,MDLZ,HSY...): obs growth 0.068, brand margin 0.238, durable ROIC 0.17, book debt-weight 0.526 (MO outlier). Defensive beta by judgment.

internet_digital_services.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (keep review_required) — internet/digital services. Only 5 comparables, META/GOOGL-dominated: growth mean-reverted from 0.184; margin 0.274; asset-light debt-weight 0.194; ROIC 0.21. Overlaps enterprise_software_cloud — refine routing before publish.

us_bank.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — depository banks valued at the equity level via residual income; deposits are operating funding, not an EV->equity debt bridge. Cross-checks: clean-surplus DDM + justified P/B.

energy_infrastructure.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — pipeline, midstream, and LNG operating companies use enterprise FCFF DCF; cycle-aware calibration remains a backtest task.

independent_power_producer.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — competitive power generation uses enterprise FCFF DCF; commodity-cycle calibration remains a backtest task.

environmental_services.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — waste and environmental-service operators use enterprise FCFF DCF; calibration remains a backtest task.

real_estate_services.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — real-estate service operating companies use enterprise FCFF DCF rather than REIT FFO; calibration remains a backtest task.

us_utility.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — regulated utilities valued via two-stage DDM on stable regulated dividends; low beta.

capital_goods_machinery.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — capital goods/machinery (CAT,DE,ITW,CMI). Calibrated 23 comps: obs growth 0.073, margin 0.17, book debt-wt 0.355 (excludes hardware 3570-3579).

retail.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — retail (WMT,TGT,HD,COST,TJX). Calibrated 20 comps; margin set to thin-retail 0.08 (obs median 0.13 inflated by franchise/restaurant names); high sales_to_capital for asset turnover. Cohort heterogeneous — split discount vs franchise later.

transportation.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — transport (UNP,CSX,UPS,DAL,FDX). Calibrated 12 comps; growth mean-reverted (obs 0.175 = post-COVID airline/cruise recovery); capital-heavy low sales_to_capital. Mixes rails/airlines — split later.

telecom.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — telecom (VZ,T,CMCSA,TMUS). Calibrated 5 comps; mature low growth, very capital-heavy (huge capex compresses FCFF). Dividend-heavy names may suit DDM better — revisit.

insurance_brokerage.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — fee-based insurance brokers and risk advisers use enterprise FCFF rather than carrier residual income; calibration remains a backtest task.

digital_asset_marketplace.model_policy_reason: WITHHOLD — digital-asset marketplaces require cycle-normalized transaction revenue, custody and customer-asset separation, and a dedicated SOTP/FCFF implementation before publication.

us_insurance.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — insurance carriers/agents valued at equity level via residual income (book + excess return); FCFF does not apply. Refine with embedded-value/P&C-vs-life split.

us_securities.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — securities/broker-dealers/exchanges via residual income; higher beta (market-sensitive).

us_credit.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — nondepository credit/consumer finance via residual income.

us_reit.model_policy_reason: CANDIDATE (review_required) — REITs valued on FFO (net income + real-estate depreciation - property-sale gains), a filing-derived non-GAAP approximation, at a governed P/FFO multiple (13-18x). DDM is inappropriate (monthly payers, growth REITs); a full AFFO/NAV model is a future refinement.
